$comment: Built-in wording for the CMS copy fields (site settings, home, about, brand and legal pages). The site uses a CMS value when it is set and falls back to these when the field is empty or the CMS does not have it yet. cms/seed/content.ts seeds the same text. {studio} is filled in everywhere; the title templates also take {game}, {mod} and {a}. Keep it general: no single game or mod.

siteSettings.footerPitch: A small team making game mods.
siteSettings.helpText: We’re a small team, and there’s room for more. If you make models or scripts, or you like testing things until they break, come and say hi.
